messages:
diego.m: Hi team — my March net was $520 lower than usual. I moved from CA -> TX on 2026-03-10 and updated my address in the HR portal on 3/11, but my stub shows CA state tax taken on PR-2026-03-31-9001. Can someone check?

nina.hr: @carla.payroll can you pull PR-2026-03-31-9001 and confirm the state code used? Diego, did you file any state withholding form or just updated the address and uploaded TX license?

diego.m: I only changed address and uploaded my TX license image. No new state W-4 because TX has no state income tax.

payroll-bot: PR-2026-03-31-9001 processed 2026-03-31 08:05 UTC. Payroll record state: CA. Federal withholding normal. (automated payroll note)

carla.payroll: Thanks. Looks like HRIS updated but the vendor sync missed the cutoff. I'll open a vendor ticket to request reversal/ refund of CA withholding and ask about an off-cycle top-up. @rachel.finance FYI for GL and accruals.

rachel.finance: If vendor can refund the withheld CA tax we can do an off-cycle net correction and reversing journal. If they can't, fallback is to correct via W-2c. Please include gross and CA withheld amounts.

diego.m: Gross for the period was $8,400. CA state withheld $520. I attached the paystub screenshot to the portal. Bank last4 is 4321.

carla.payroll: Ticket PAY-4599 created with vendor; requesting expedited refund and an off-cycle deposit of +$520 net. Also confirming employment type — you're full-time W-2, correct?

diego.m: Correct, W-2.

nina.hr: I added the TX license scan and address-change confirmation to PAY-4599 and set a block to prevent further CA withholding on future runs. Marking Diego's record as pending payroll sync. :white_check_mark:

payroll-bot: PAY-4599 logged. SLA: 72 hours. Current status: vendor triage. Next update expected 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC.

carla.payroll: Vendor estimated 2 business days. If approved we'll schedule off-cycle next Tue; if not possible we'll reverse in next regular run and handle accounting. If neither, W-2c will be issued. I'll update this thread when I hear back.

diego.m: Appreciate it — please ping me if any docs needed. Also curious if this is a recurring sync issue after moves?

nina.hr: We're looking into the HRIS -> payroll sync timing around run cutoffs to tighten it up; filing an internal ops follow-up after PAY-4599.

rachel.finance: For accounting please hold code "tax_miswithhold_ca" until resolution. We'll want entries for both the refund and any off-cycle.

carla.payroll: Noted. Updated PAY-4599 with Diego's bank last4 and paystub link. Standing by for vendor confirm.
